status_definitions.partial_coverage_candidate: Some relevant profile evidence is present; this is not complete core, scoreability, readiness or recommendation.
status_definitions.core_coverage_complete: All preliminary mandatory singleton and OR groups are evidenced; eligibility is reported independently.
status_definitions.profile_eligible: Identity, time, conflict, human approval, traceability and explicit compatibility gates pass.

suv.compatibility_key_note: Historical key only; no SUV body-style requirement.

interpretation.purpose: Readiness and collection planning only. No new score, profile weights or runtime integration in this version.
interpretation.optional: Missing optional fields never block a complete core. Full matrix coverage is reported separately from core coverage.
interpretation.safety: V3 equipment rubric requires individually documented airbags, ABS and ESC. Explicit absence is evidence, not an invented zero; availability does not certify crash safety.
interpretation.body_type: Descriptive mandatory evidence for Espaço/capacidade (historical key suv). Not inferred from collection group, silhouette or model name; no body-style bonus, SUV classification or exclusivity imposed.
interpretation.fuel: Common explicit gasoline price/distance scenario from v3; derived estimate is not observed ANP or complete TCO.
interpretation.conflicts: All unresolved source or identity conflicts remain blockers, even if an affected measurement is not in this core.
interpretation.coverage: Count present mandatory singleton groups plus satisfied OR groups, divided by total mandatory groups. No score multiplied by coverage.
interpretation.identity: Unique FIPE code/year keys, reviewed catalog trim, source hashes and pending substitution approvals are independent gates.
interpretation.legacy: Price-label crosswalk repairs only the recorded price-reference spelling, not a catalog-to-Gold mapping or approval of a different trim.
